text.en:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat combatants using this weapon or with Transmutation spheres, or destroy Eyes of Savathûn to unlock this upgrade.

Kills, or damaging <link Champions, Minibosses, or Bosses [#CombatantClassifications] />, with your Transmutation Sphere (inconsistently) grants <pve 30% /> <pvp [15%] /> increased weapon damage for 7 seconds.
